product.name: KnockOUT hospitality/restaurant operations
product.summary: Multi-tenant restaurant operations with table service, parcels, inventory, finance, workforce and company subscriptions. Lodging PMS workflows were not found.
product.method: Static source and schema analysis; no live UI/session, external delivery, payment or deployment verification.

technologies.web: React 19, Vite 7, custom JSX/CSS, lucide icons, motion
technologies.mobile: Expo 57, React Native 0.86.3, StyleSheet, AsyncStorage; no Flutter
technologies.backend: Nest 11 bootstrap with Express route handlers, raw mysql2 queries
technologies.database: MariaDB; separate tenant databases and master registry; no ORM
technologies.authentication: PIN login and custom HMAC bearer sessions, 12-hour expiry; no JWT refresh/MFA found
technologies.state: React hooks plus browser session/local storage; native AsyncStorage; shared /state snapshots
technologies.infrastructure: Docker Compose, role APIs behind master routing, MariaDB, Redis and MinIO/S3
technologies.realtime: WebSocket state invalidation and refresh, polling fallback in some clients
technologies.payments: Cash/Card-UPI recording and SaaS reference input; no verified payment gateway found
technologies.notifications: Local feedback plus outbound email/SMS/webhook code; delivery availability depends on configuration

roles.name: admin
roles.goal: Keep restaurant operations and cash records coordinated
roles.dailyTasks: Monitor floor; create parcels and bookings; settle bills; update stock and suppliers; manage staff
roles.painPoints: Ten ungrouped web links; bookings cannot be seated; web/native settings differ

roles.name: waiter
roles.goal: Move table service from order to paid bill
roles.dailyTasks: Choose table; submit rounds; collect/receive prepared items; request bill; record own shift on mobile
roles.painPoints: My Orders relies on name matching; web attendance hidden

roles.name: chef
roles.goal: Prepare food and coordinate kitchen resources
roles.dailyTasks: Review batches; start preparation; mark ready; toggle dishes; request stock on web; maintain roster
roles.painPoints: Native roster/stock tools have reduced coverage

roles.name: juicer
roles.goal: Prepare and hand off juice items
roles.dailyTasks: Review juice queue; prepare; mark ready; control juice availability; record own shift
roles.painPoints: Ready web navigation uses kitchen gate; mobile parcel grouping differs

roles.name: superadmin
roles.dailyTasks: Review applicants; inspect companies/users; manage access and SaaS invoices
roles.painPoints: Technical database names and credentials visible; mobile is much narrower

roles.name: applicant
roles.dailyTasks: Submit business/contact/package; await review; enter activation details; receive permanent credentials
roles.painPoints: Payment and message wording suggests more integration than is implemented

workflows.name: Reserve a restaurant table
steps: Enter phone, date, time, duration and table
Server validates future interval and overlap
workflows.limitations: No guest/room/rates/taxes/discount/deposit/special-request fields; no modification, seating, hotel check-in or hotel check-out. Active reservation blocks new table order without a consume/seat action.
workflows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    N0["Open Table Bookings calendar"] --> N1
    N1["Select day and create booking"] --> N2
    N2["Enter phone, date, time, duration and table"] --> N3
    N3["Server validates future interval and overlap"] --> N4
    N4["Confirmed booking; delivery attempt"] --> N5
    N5["Cancel if needed"]

workflows.name: Dine-in service and settlement
steps: Select items and submit order or additional round
Mark ready; collect and receive handoff
workflows.limitations: Production, handoff and payment are separate states; do not collapse them into one status. No gateway confirmation.
workflows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    N0["Waiter opens available table"] --> N1
    N1["Select items and submit order or additional round"] --> N2
    N2["Chef/Juicer prepares matching ticket items"] --> N3

uxProblems.problem: Booking cannot progress to seated service
uxProblems.why: Confirmed interval locks order creation; seated status has no reachable transition.
uxProblems.recommendation: Design an explicit booking arrival/seating handoff after product/backend decision; not an existing feature.

uxProblems.why: A text reference is accepted without a verified gateway result.
uxProblems.recommendation: Distinguish recording a reference from payment verification and activation policy.

uxProblems.problem: UI module visibility is not complete authorization
uxProblems.why: Some order/parcel paths lack module mapping; role API settings/report/upload guards differ from UI.
uxProblems.recommendation: Align backend permissions before treating hidden navigation as access control.

uxProblems.problem: Financial information and credentials have broad exposure
uxProblems.why: Shared state includes finance data; master user views expose PINs.
uxProblems.recommendation: Define least-privilege data and credential presentation with engineering.

uxProblems.why: Charge fields are editable while server bill tax/service totals are zero; web hides fields.
uxProblems.recommendation: Use one agreed billing policy and show only operative settings.

uxProblems.why: State feed bounds orders and filters bookings; old/cancelled data can appear empty.
uxProblems.recommendation: Show retention and loading scope; design server-backed history before promising it.

uxProblems.problem: My Orders is attributed by name
uxProblems.why: First-name matching can merge users or omit mobile-created Mobile Waiter orders.
uxProblems.recommendation: Use stable staff attribution; show current ownership criteria until fixed.

uxProblems.why: A full attendance component exists but sidebar entries are disabled.
uxProblems.recommendation: Decide parity and add a deliberate staff entry in future design.

uxProblems.problem: Global search and bell are decorative
uxProblems.why: No interaction handler implements search or notification inbox.
uxProblems.recommendation: Remove affordance from current-state prototypes or clearly scope future implementation.

uxProblems.problem: Native and web login paths differ
uxProblems.why: Native requires Hotel ID and six-digit PIN; master/applicant flows differ.
uxProblems.recommendation: Design explicit supported identity paths and recovery states.

uxProblems.why: The shared ready key maps to kitchen.
uxProblems.recommendation: Use role-aware feature gating and explicit denied/disabled states.

uxProblems.problem: Authenticated navigation has no deep links
uxProblems.why: Reload/back/history cannot reliably restore selected screen, date or company.
uxProblems.recommendation: Define route/state persistence in future IA; do not document invented URLs as current.

uxProblems.why: Ten flat web links, grouped mobile drawer; Chef Management vs native Juicer.
uxProblems.recommendation: Group by daily operations, resources and administration with task-consistent labels.

uxProblems.problem: Sent message is not verified delivery
uxProblems.why: Queued notification can be presented as sent; no durable dispatch worker verified.
uxProblems.recommendation: Represent queued, sent and failed separately with truthful feedback.

uxProblems.problem: Technical database names surface in company navigation
uxProblems.why: Infrastructure identifiers compete with business identity.
uxProblems.recommendation: Put diagnostics behind support details; keep company identity primary.

uxProblems.problem: Stock forecasting can be mistaken for automated purchasing
uxProblems.why: Forecast uses recorded usage/waste and minimum thresholds; request resolution is separate.
uxProblems.recommendation: Show calculation basis, coverage and manual next actions.

uxProblems.why: Old Finance, Staff, FoodManager and native alternatives are not current navigation.
uxProblems.recommendation: Exclude dormant views from current redesign scope unless deliberately reactivated.
